proposed_comments.title: Limit mnemonic suppression to shelf shortcuts
proposed_comments.body:
### Limit mnemonic suppression to shelf shortcuts

**Severity:** `medium`

`WM_MENUCHAR` is sent for every unmatched mnemonic in the main window, not only for the new shelf shortcuts. Returning `MNC_CLOSE` unconditionally therefore changes unrelated Alt-key and menu behavior. Limit the special handling to the shelf's documented numeric access keys so all other mnemonics retain the default window-procedure behavior.

```suggestion
case PInvoke.WM_MENUCHAR when wParam.Value is >= (nuint)'0' and <= (nuint)'9':
    return (LRESULT)(1 << 16); // MAKELRESULT(0, MNC_CLOSE)
```

confidence.rationale: WM_MENUCHAR is window-wide, while the new shelf shortcuts are specifically Alt+0 through Alt+9; the scoped case preserves the intended chime workaround without intercepting unrelated mnemonics.
